defects.title: n8n MCP test surface unavailable in this run
defects.observed: The connected n8n MCP search_workflows and test paths returned fetch failed.
defects.impact: No live n8n execution receipt can be claimed from this run.
defects.reproduction: Execute the n8n MCP search_workflows action from the Hyperagent developer lane.
defects.next_action: Restore or re-verify the n8n MCP transport, then run pinned tests against inactive or dedicated staging workflows only.

defects.title: Company-brain wrapper could not clone the current toolkit
defects.observed: The credentialed kb-memory wrapper exited before returning a brain or ledger result and left no /tmp/octools checkout.
defects.impact: This run uses repository-grounded architecture receipts rather than claiming a successful company-brain recall.
defects.reproduction: Run the current kb-memory wrapper with a read-only company-brain query in this runtime.
defects.next_action: Re-run the wrapper when its repository fetch path is healthy; do not treat this offline harness report as a substitute for the brain ledger.

defects.title: Live channel receipts are not covered by offline evidence
defects.observed: The current run proves 59 synthetic scenarios and zero external effects only.
defects.impact: Email delivery, phone ingress, SMS ingress, Intercom ticket creation, n8n routing, provider callbacks, and response-time SLOs remain unproven.
defects.reproduction: Run the staged channel adapter suite with pinned data and receipt capture after n8n transport is restored.
defects.next_action: Create a dedicated staging receipt plan with synthetic recipients, pinned n8n inputs, and provider test endpoints; never use a real customer or a mass-send path.

defects.title: Human resolution, queue ownership, and CSAT timing remain unmeasured
defects.observed: The harness checks routing decisions but does not create live Intercom objects or measure staff response.
defects.impact: A control can be logically correct yet operationally abandoned without a named owner and receipt.
defects.reproduction: Run a bounded synthetic case through the staging Intercom/n8n path and capture assignment, acknowledgment, resolution, and CSAT records.
defects.next_action: Add a receipt schema for owner, queue, timestamps, resolution evidence, and no-customer-action guarantees before any live cohort.
